content: Indication-specific dosing for the combination of activin, leucoanthocyanin, and Muscat grape seed extract is as follows: Procyanidin extract: Administer 150-300 mg orally once daily. Tablets or capsules: Administer 75-300 mg per day for 3 weeks, followed by a maintenance dose of 40-80 mg per day, or alternatively, 360 mg or 720 mg once daily (e.g., Antistax, Boehringer Ingelheim). Procyanidin extract for endometriosis: Administer 200-300 mg orally once daily. Endometriosis (based on randomized controlled trials): Administer 30 mg orally twice daily. Indications: This combination has been studied for various conditions, including: Atherosclerosis Attention deficit disorder Cancer prevention Chronic venous insufficiency Prevention of collagen breakdown Prevention of dental caries Macular degeneration Peripheral vascular disease Poor night vision Retinopathy Varicose veins Endometriosis Efficacy: Demonstrated effectiveness in alleviating symptoms of circulatory disorders. One randomized controlled trial (RCT) suggests it is effective in reducing symptoms of endometriosis (Kohama, J. Reprod Med). Not effective in addressing signs of aging or preventing collagen destruction. Adverse Effects: No adverse effects have been reported in the literature. However, there is a potential risk of hepatotoxicity. Contraindications: None reported. Pregnancy and Lactation: Pregnancy Category: Not applicable (N/A). Lactation: Not applicable (N/A). Generally considered acceptable. Controlled studies in pregnant women have shown no evidence of fetal risk. Cost Information: No specific cost details provided.
